analysis: Large-Amount Uplift Scaling & Economic Value Decomposition

root_cause_verdict.finding_1: The T-Learner suffers from significant baseline probability underestimation in the CONTROL arm under S1 (Predicted P(Control): 40.0% vs True P(Control): 50.5%, Bias: -10.5%). This causes the model to artificially overestimate uplift tau(a) = P(a) - P(control) by +10% across all actions!
root_cause_verdict.finding_2: For high-ticket cases (>= INR 3,000), this +10% uplift overestimation creates a massive phantom revenue premium of +INR 300 to +INR 1,000 per case. Because ESCALATE has the highest raw predicted probability (67.8%), the phantom premium easily overwhelms the INR 100 cost, leading the policy to over-escalate aggressively.
